title: ReportFinding
description: One structured finding from the blind analyser agent, which sees only the serial reference, the parallel version, and the test harness — never PlantedBug data.

typeKey.description: Taxonomy item key (see taxonomy.json) this finding is classified as.

lines.description: One or more 1-indexed line numbers into the run's parallelVersion where the finding applies.

explanation.description: Short, in the analyser's own words — one or two sentences, not an essay.
